agents.name: Envoy
agents.description: A smooth-tongued representative of the house. His presence at a foreign court sweetens any terms laid before it, and leaderless bands of soldiers have been known to find his purse more persuasive than their cause.

agents.name: Informer
agents.description: A trader in secrets. Settled in a foreign city he counts its garrison and reads its mood; when an army storms the walls, his opened gate is worth a siege tower.

agents.name: Hired Blade
agents.description: A quiet solution to a loud problem. Success sharpens his craft; failure tends to be its own punishment. Wary targets with careful retinues are far harder marks.
